claim: Where the character is looking. Gaze is how a frame directs the audience's attention and how two shots are stitched into one conversation.
look_at: at_viewer and away are reliable. off_screen is the useful one for dialogue - it implies a second person without needing to render them.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes

panels.clause: looking at viewer, direct eye contact
looking off screen to the side, at someone out of frame
